{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "ULTRA MASTER PROMPT – STATIC RESTAURANT COMMUNITY WEBSITE

Create a modern premium static website for a neighborhood restaurant + entertainment community called “Table & Tempo Social Kitchen”. It is not just a restaurant, it is a local hangout for dinner, acoustic nights, comedy evenings, vinyl brunch, chef talks, poetry open-mic and small community celebrations.

IMPORTANT TECH LIMITS:
- Build as a pure static front-end website only.
- Use React + Tailwind CSS.
- No backend, no database, no login, no booking system that actually submits anywhere.
- No API calls, no realtime data, no external services required.
- All menus, events, reviews, photos, schedules, community posts must be mock/static sample content inside the project.
- Forms can be visual only, with fake success state or disabled/static demo behavior.
- Must run as a static site.

OVERALL STYLE:
- Modern, clean, premium but warm.
- Inspired by Notion layout language: modular cards, soft borders, clean typography, database/table style sections, toggles/accordion blocks, page-like sections, subtle icon labels, organized content blocks.
- Not a boring corporate restaurant page. It should feel like a living community board + editorial restaurant magazine + event calendar.
- Visual mood: warm ivory background, charcoal text, burnt orange, sage green, wine red accents, soft paper texture feeling, rounded cards, elegant shadows, subtle gradients.
- Must be very polished and responsive.
- Desktop, tablet, mobile layouts all carefully designed.
- Use scroll-driven storytelling: as user scrolls, sections should feel like chapters of the restaurant story.
- Add subtle scroll animations using CSS/React only, no heavy libraries required. Parallax-like background shapes are ok if simple CSS.

WEBSITE STRUCTURE / PAGE CONTENT:

1. STICKY TOP NAVIGATION
- Logo: Table & Tempo
- Small subtitle: Social Kitchen
- Nav links: Story, Menu, Events, Community, Gallery, Visit
- CTA button: Reserve a Table (visual only, scrolls to reservation section)
- Mobile hamburger menu required.
- Sticky with glass blur and changes slightly after scrolling.

2. HERO SECTION
Headline:
“Dinner, music, and neighborhood stories at one long table.”
Subheadline:
“A warm social kitchen where seasonal plates meet local performers, weekend rituals, and community nights.”
Buttons:
- View This Week
- Explore Menu
Hero design:
- Split layout.
- Left side editorial text.
- Right side large rounded image/card collage using placeholder food/event images or gradient blocks.
- Add Notion-like info widgets: “Tonight: Acoustic Folk 8PM”, “Chef’s Table: 12 seats”, “Community Board: 18 notes”.
- Add floating tags: live music, shared plates, local art, vinyl brunch.
- Background with warm gradient blobs but minimal.

3. SCROLL STORY SECTION – “How the night unfolds”
Create a timeline that animates/appears while scrolling:
- 5:30 PM doors open, candlelight and aperitivo
- 6:45 PM shared plates begin
- 8:00 PM live set / comedy / poetry depending on night
- 9:30 PM dessert, vinyl, late conversations
- 11:00 PM closing toast
Use vertical timeline on desktop, compact cards on mobile.
Each item should have icon, time, title, short description.

4. NOTION-STYLE WEEKLY PROGRAM DATABASE
Section title: “This Week at Table & Tempo”
Make it look like a beautiful Notion database/calendar hybrid.
Static event cards/table:
Columns or filters visually only:
- All
- Music
- Food
- Community
- Family
- Late Night
Events:
- Tuesday: Neighborhood Pasta Night – $18 bowls, communal table
- Wednesday: Open Mic Poetry – warm lights, 12 reader slots
- Thursday: Vinyl & Natural Wine – guest selector Maya Lane
- Friday: Acoustic Supper Club – indie folk duo
- Saturday: Chef’s Market Menu – seasonal tasting plates
- Sunday: Family Brunch & Sketch Table – kids drawing corner
Each card should include time, mood tag, price/free tag, short copy, tiny CTA “Details”.
No real ticketing. Details can open static modal or expand card if simple, but no backend.

5. MENU SECTION
Create rich restaurant menu with categories:
- Small Plates
- From the Hearth
- Bowls & Greens
- Sweets
- Drinks
Use Notion card/table style with dish name, description, price, tags.
Example dishes:
Small Plates:
- Charred Carrot Hummus, seed crunch, chili oil – $12
- Crispy Halloumi Bites, citrus honey, mint – $14
- Market Pickle Board, sourdough, whipped butter – $11
From the Hearth:
- Wood-Roasted Chicken, lemon jus, herbs – $28
- Smoky Mushroom Flatbread, taleggio, thyme – $21
- Harissa Lamb Skewers, yogurt, cucumber – $26
Bowls & Greens:
- Tempo Grain Bowl, farro, greens, roasted squash – $18
- Little Gem Caesar, anchovy crumb, parmesan – $16
Sweets:
- Olive Oil Cake, orange cream – $10
- Chocolate Spoon Pudding, sea salt – $11
Drinks:
- House Spritz – $13
- Zero Proof Garden Fizz – $9
- Rotating Natural Wine Glass – $14
Add dietary tags: vegetarian, gluten-free option, spicy, community favorite.
Include a “Tonight’s Board” card with 3 changing specials but static sample content.

6. FEATURED COMMUNITY SECTION
Title: “More than a dining room”
Grid of community blocks:
- Local Artist Wall: rotating neighborhood artwork
- Long Table Fund: monthly meal donations
- Skill Swap Sundays: teach something, learn something
- Cookbook Shelf: borrow a cookbook, leave a note
- Birthday Corner: small celebrations without fuss
- Quiet Lunch Hours: softer music, laptop-friendly tables
Design like Notion pages/cards with icons, little labels and short descriptions.

7. SCROLL-DRIVEN FEATURE STRIP
Create a visually interesting horizontal-feeling section (can be vertical on mobile) with sticky text on left and changing cards on right as you scroll.
Theme: “Pick your kind of night”
Cards:
- Date Night: candlelit two-top, shared dessert, acoustic set
- Friends Night: snacks, pitchers, booth seating, loud laughs
- Solo Night: bar seat, book, bowl of pasta, no pressure
- Family Brunch: pancakes, sketch table, gentle playlist
- Late Vinyl: low lights, natural wine, crate digging
This should be static but feel dynamic with scroll reveal.

8. GALLERY SECTION
Masonry-style gallery with placeholder image tiles.
Categories labels:
- plates
- people
- stage
- details
- brunch
Use CSS gradients or local placeholder image URLs if needed, but no live image API. It must still look good if images are simple colored blocks with text overlays.
Add captions like:
- “Friday supper club before the first chorus”
- “The corner booth everyone asks for”
- “Market tomatoes, torn basil, loud olive oil”

9. TESTIMONIALS / COMMUNITY NOTES
Notion-style quote cards / sticky notes.
Static reviews, no external review widgets.
Examples:
- “Feels like the neighborhood living room, if the living room had incredible flatbread.” — Priya, regular since 2024
- “I came for open mic and stayed for dessert.” — Mateo, poet
- “The Sunday brunch is chaos in the best possible way.” — Lina, parent
- “Best solo dinner spot in the city.” — Evan
Make the layout charming and asymmetrical.

10. RESERVATION / VISIT SECTION
This is visual only.
Title: “Save yourself a seat”
Include static form fields:
- Name
- Date
- Time
- Party size
- Occasion
- Notes
Button: Request Table
When clicked, it may show fake confirmation text like “Demo only: your table request preview is ready.” No server.
Add clear microcopy: “Static demo form — no real booking is submitted.”
Also include:
Address: 42 Juniper Lane, North Quarter
Hours:
Tue–Thu 5:30–10
Fri–Sat 5:30–11:30
Sun 10–3 brunch
Mon closed
Phone: (555) 014-8820
Email: hello@tabletempo.example
Map area should be a designed static illustrated map card, not Google Maps embed.

11. FOOTER
- Logo and short paragraph
- Links: Menu, Events, Community, Visit
- Newsletter visual input only with fake button
- Social labels: Instagram, TikTok, Spotify Playlist, Local Board
- Copyright 2026 Table & Tempo Social Kitchen
- Add small note: “Static concept site built with sample content.”

INTERACTIONS REQUIRED:
- Smooth scrolling navigation.
- Mobile menu open/close.
- Visual filter buttons in event section can switch active style, optional static filtering is fine.
- Menu category tabs should switch visible category or scroll to category.
- Accordion or expandable cards for event details.
- Fake reservation submit success message.
- Scroll reveal animations for major sections.
- Sticky storytelling elements where appropriate.
- Hover states on cards/buttons.

DESIGN DETAILS:
- Use Tailwind utility classes.
- Componentize sections cleanly.
- Use semantic HTML.
- Use accessible contrast.
- Buttons and form fields must have focus states.
- Use lucide-react icons if available, otherwise simple text icons are ok.
- Use CSS only for decorative patterns: dotted grid, paper grain, soft shadows, border lines.
- No canvas, no WebGL, no 3D.
- No game-like mechanics.

DELIVERABLE:
A complete static React + Tailwind website in one project. It should look like a real high-end restaurant/community entertainment website, not a wireframe. All content can be mock/sample. Make it visually complex, scroll-driven, responsive, and polished with Notion-inspired organization.",

 "gate_keywords": [
  "Table & Tempo Social Kitchen",
  "Dinner, music, and neighborhood stories at one long table.",

  "Community Board: 18 notes",

  "This Week at Table & Tempo",

 ]
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
# webdev-structural-gate@1: necessary conditions, not a replacement judge.
_gate_layout = {}
for _line in (shot["output"] or "").splitlines():
    if _line.startswith("LAYOUT:"):
        try:
            _gate_layout = json.loads(_line[len("LAYOUT:"):])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
        break
if (not isinstance(_gate_layout, dict) or _gate_layout.get("error")
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("text"), str)
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("scroll_w"), (int, float))
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("client_w"), (int, float))
        or _gate_layout["client_w"] <= 0):
    done(None, "Structural measurements unavailable; not scored.")
_gate_text = " ".join(_gate_layout["text"].split())
_gate_kw = cfg.get("gate_keywords") or []
_gate_fails = []
if not _gate_text:
    _gate_fails.append("blank rendered DOM")
if _gate_kw and not any(_kw.casefold() in _gate_text.casefold() for _kw in _gate_kw):
    _gate_fails.append("no brief-keyword DOM presence")
if _gate_layout["scroll_w"] > _gate_layout["client_w"] + 1:
    _gate_fails.append("horizontal overflow")
_gate_report = {"passed": not _gate_fails, "failed": _gate_fails,
                "dom_chars": len(_gate_text), "keywords": _gate_kw,
                "layout": _gate_layout}
(V / "structural_gates.json").write_text(json.dumps(_gate_report, indent=1))
if _gate_fails:
    done(0.0, "Structural gates failed: " + "; ".join(_gate_fails),
         structural_gates=_gate_fails)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Gate trivial, off-brief and overflowing pages to a scored 0 before the vision call, cutting judge spend and the blank-page lottery. Passing pages reach the judge unchanged.

gate_keywords: Dinner, music, and neighborhood stories at one long table.
